# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the focused change and its actual completion status.

## Motivation

Explain the problem and link the relevant issue or learning objective.

## Evidence

Link reproducible artifacts and technical sources. Distinguish predictions from
observations; mark missing evidence as Not started or To be validated.

## Testing

List checks actually run, outcomes and anything not tested. For experiments,
include hardware, software versions, model revision and configuration.

## Performance implications

State whether performance is affected. Link controlled measurements if
available; otherwise write Not measured. Do not make unsupported improvement
claims.

## Documentation changes

List updated documentation and any follow-up needed.

## Privacy/security check

- [ ] No employer-confidential information, client configuration or private
      repository content.
- [ ] No patient information or protected health information.
- [ ] No credentials, internal hostnames or IP addresses, including in outputs.
- [ ] No claims on behalf of any employer, client or organization.
- [ ] Generated material has been reviewed for accuracy where applicable.
- [ ] Planned work is clearly marked; no invented results or contribution
      history.
